intent_en: To illustrate the demographic proportions of Sunni and Shia Muslims and the friction between these groups.
previous_intent: To illustrate the demographic composition of the Muslim world, showing that Sunnis constitute the vast majority while Shias are a minority, and to highlight the tension between hardline factions of both groups.
narration_support: Sunnis make up about 80 % of the Muslim world and Shia about 20%. And the hardliners on both sides don't like each other very much.
chart_support: Block chart titled 'MUSLIM FAITHS' showing a large green area and a smaller red area labeled 'SHIA ≈ 20%', visualizing the proportional split between the two groups.
evidence_note: The narration provides the specific percentages and mentions the conflict, while the chart visualizes the majority-minority split (green vs red) under the title 'MUSLIM FAITHS'.
